Title: RabbitMQ Extension for Windows and Linux is now generally available

Body.Content:
The RabbitMQ Extension for Azure Functions is now generally available on our Premium and Dedicated plans for Windows and Linux. This extension enables your functions to respond to messages from a RabbitMQ queue using a trigger and send messages to RabbitMQ using an output binding.

Learn more.

Visit the GitHub repository.
